# `utf` standard library

The `utf` module provides UTF-8 rune encoding and decoding utilities for `String`, `Builder`, and raw memory addresses (`Addr`).

```{.dva .run}
#use utf
```

## Function catalog

| Function | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `utf::append_rune` | `Builder, Rune => ()` | Appends the 1–4 byte UTF-8 encoding of a `Rune` to a `Builder` |
| `utf::append_codepoint` | `Builder, Int => ()` | Appends the UTF-8 encoding of an integer codepoint to a `Builder` |
| `utf::encode_rune` | `Rune => String` | Encodes a `Rune` into a newly allocated UTF-8 `String` |
| `utf::encode_codepoint` | `Int => String` | Encodes an integer codepoint into a newly allocated UTF-8 `String` |
| `utf::decode_rune_addr` | `Addr, Int => Rune` | Decodes the UTF-8 rune at `p + i` (returns `U+FFFD` on invalid sequence) |
| `utf::decode_rune_builder` | `Builder, Int => Rune` | Bounds-checked UTF-8 rune decode at byte offset `i` in `Builder` |

```{.dva .run}
#use io
#use utf

s = utf::encode_rune('λ')
io::out(?s)
// => 2
```
